QuestInfo.name: To Perion
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p 1103001##k about what the #rPuppeteer's goal#k is.
QuestInfo.1: #p 1103001# says that he will call for help from other knights at #m130000000# to protect #m100000000#, and he wants you to continue #bpursuing the Puppeteer#k. It looks like #p 1103004# of #m102000000# needs help... Go to #b#m102000000##k and meet #bInformant #p 1103004##k.
QuestInfo.2: You met #b#p 1103004##k. She's actually pretty cute!

0.0: The Puppeteer was never much of a threat in the past, but I guess #rthings change#k. We should ask the good folks of #m130000000# to join the fight. #h0#, you'll do the honors, right?
0.1: It's the only way I can think of to continue our #binvestigation on the Puppeteer#k... Unless you want to wait for me to dream up some better ideas, but that could take weeks and weeks of uninterrupted napping.
0.2: Meet up with #p1103004##k, our informant in #b#m102000000##k. I'll dream-message our situation to her while you travel there.\r\nAre you ready to carry out your next mission? If so, I'll send you to Perion right away!

no.0: I hope you don't expect ME to go...

1.0: Hiya! #p1103001# spoke in my head to tell me you were coming! You're #b#h0##k, right? #p1103001# said you didn't bring him enough cheesecake when you were in #m100000000#!

npc.0: Go to #b#m102000000##k. You can get there from #b#m104020000##k.
